title: Quick Spin options
description: Restart VPinFE after changing these settings.

options.name: Custom loading image
options.description: Filename inside this theme's img folder. PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF; at most 3 MiB, 1920 pixels per side and 2.1 million pixels total. Leave blank for the built-in loading screen.

options.name: Loading image rotation
options.description: Rotate the custom image to match your cabinet. The theme fits the rotated image within the screen.

options.name: Use VPinFE frontend audio
options.description: Keep VPinFE's normal frontend audio handling enabled.
